name: sarf
description: Crosses every Arabic triliteral root against every morphological pattern to surface the words that are grammatically legal but have no referent yet — the slots waiting for something to be invented.
author: Nishad Kaippally <kaippsCafe@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: npm run build-db && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm run build-db
